run_mjwarp_viewer: run the mjwarp-viewer CLI to load and simulate an MJCF file with MuJoCo Warp
create_warp_step_function: create a Warp step function that copies MuJoCo data to Warp arrays and launches physics simulation
create_c_step_function: create a C-engine step function that wraps mujoco.mj_step with optional control sequence injection
compile_physics_step: compile a physics step into a CUDA graph for optimized Warp simulation execution
run_passive_viewer: run a passive MuJoCo viewer with space-bar pause and period-key single-step controls
